description.short_caption: Engorged tick, likely a vector for infectious diseases.
description.detailed_description: This is a clinical photograph of an engorged tick, with a rounded body and visible legs extending from the anterior portion. The tick appears to be in a fully fed state, as indicated by the distended abdomen. The image is clear and focused, showing the characteristic morphology of a tick, including its segmented body and small head. The background is plain, emphasizing the tick as the central subject.
visible_findings: visible legs extending from anterior portion
